summary: The CourseAssessment module provides functionality for managing course assessments within the HSPnet system. It includes procedures for adding, updating, deleting, and searching course assessments, as well as validating assessment data.
purpose: To manage and facilitate various operations related to course assessments in an educational context, ensuring accurate, efficient, and secure handling of assessment data.
